# Yardstick: digits of our Fortran oracle vs `results/` (plan Task 3b)

<!-- generated by `python reference/reference_runs.py --docs`; edit reference/reference_docs.py, not this file -->

Digits are testreport's (`tools/testreport_jax.py`, a literal port of `verification/testreport`'s comparison): 16 = every printed digit equal, 22 = every value zero in both files, `--` = no comparison (fewer than 2 lines, or line counts differ). Our oracle: gfortran 11.2.0 build of master 63cdc0b with testreport's options (`reference/README.md`); runs in `docs/REFERENCE_RUNS.md`. The variables are testreport's check list of each variant (`tr_checklist`, else the default list); testreport decides on the first one only, acceptance (plan Overview) reads every one.

## Yardstick: our oracle's STDOUT vs `results/`

| variant | runs (STDOUT) | deciding variable | its digits | lowest compared digits | not compared |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| tutorial_barotropic_gyre/input | job27826873-plain | PS | 16 | 16 | - |
| tutorial_baroclinic_gyre/input | job27826873-plain | PS | 16 | 16 | - |
| advect_xy/input | job27826873-plain | Tsd | 16 | 14 | PS |
| advect_xy/input.ab3_c4 | job27826873-plain | Tsd | 16 | 16 | PS |
| advect_xz/input | job27826873-plain | Tsd | 16 | 16 | PS |
| advect_xz/input.nlfs | job27826873-plain | Tsd | 16 | 14 | PS |
| advect_xz/input.pqm | job27826873-plain | Tsd | 16 | 12 | PS |
| global_ocean.90x40x15/input | job27826873-plain | PS | 16 | 16 | - |
| tutorial_global_oce_optim/input_ad | fdzero + yardstick | admGrd | 0 | 16 | Tmn Tmx Tav Tsd Smn Smx Sav Ssd Umn Umx Uav Usd Vmn Vmx Vav Vsd |

The lowest-digits column excludes admGrd of the forward-only code_ad builds (0 by construction, see the proposals). Every compared variable of the jaxdump runs (dumps off and on) and of the repeat runs has the same STDOUT numbers as the yardstick run (section 'Repeat and instrumented runs'; M2: the invisibility table).

## Variables below 10 digits, or not compared: proposals for Nikolay (not decided)

**No compared check-list variable of any M1 variant is below 10 digits:** our gfortran `-O0` build of master
reaches 12 to 16 digits against `results/` everywhere (lowest: `advect_xz/input.pqm` Smn 12, Tmn 13; `advect_xy/input`
Tmn/Tmx 14; `advect_xz/input.nlfs` Smn/Smx/Ssd 14). The Task 2 hint (global_ocean.90x40x15 PS agreeing only to 10 digits
between checkpoints 65z and 67v) does not show here: our master build gives PS 16 digits against the current
`results/output.txt`.

Proposal 1 (forward acceptance per variant): JAX vs our own oracle's STDOUT >= 13 digits for every check-list
variable, or bitwise where the oracle comparison is bitwise; and JAX vs `results/` >= the yardstick digits of the table
above for every variable, not only the deciding one (testreport's verdict reads only the first variable and passes a
NaN in any other, Task 2).

Proposal 2 (roundoff-level variables): the second-tiling runs below show that some check-list variables are means of
fields whose value is at roundoff level (barotropic gyre Uav, Vav; baroclinic gyre Ssd, Vav; advect_xz Uav): changing
only the tile layout of the Fortran itself changes them by O(1) relative (0 digits) at a field-scale difference of
~1e-15. Our build reaches 16 digits on them against `results/` only because it sums in the reference's tile order.
For these variables require the JAX global sums in the Fortran tile and loop order (PORTING_RULES §4) and gate them at
the yardstick; if a JAX layout cannot sum in that order, compare them relative to the field scale (`<f>_max`) at the
1e-13 class instead of in testreport digits. Listed per variant in the invariance table ("0 digits" entries).

Variables testreport cannot compare (`--`) and what is proposed for each:
- `advect_xy` (both variants) and `advect_xz` (all three) **PS**: these experiments run with `momStepping=.FALSE.`,
  so neither our STDOUT nor `results/` has a `cg2d_init_res` line (testreport: "Not enough lines"). Proposal: JAX
  prints no `cg2d_init_res` line either (the same `--`); the deciding variable is Tsd (16 digits).
- `tutorial_global_oce_optim/input_ad` **admGrd** (testreport's deciding variable) is 0 digits by construction: the
  forward-only build prints the adjoint gradient it reads from the zero `adxx_qnet` file (option (i)), i.e. 0. It is
  not an oracle value; the TAF reference value comes only from `results/output_adm.txt`. Proposal: the JAX adjoint
  gradient is gated against `results/output_adm.txt` at >= 10 digits (plan Overview, unchanged), and against the
  oracle's FD gradient (admFwd) by the gradient trust protocol.
- `tutorial_global_oce_optim/input_ad` adm **T+ S+ U+ V+** (`dynstat_ad*`): `results/output_adm.txt` has no adjoint
  monitor lines and a forward-only build prints none; testreport gives `--` for the TAF build too. Proposal: no
  reference comparison in M1 (plan Task 16: self-consistency test only), as planned.
- `tutorial_global_oce_optim/input_ad` **admCst** and **admFwd**: 16 digits (every printed digit equal) with option (i);
  the forward-only build's forward `%MON` lines also agree with the forward lines of `results/output_adm.txt` to 16
  digits in every default-list variable.

Findings: the forward state is not bitwise tile-invariant in the Fortran itself (global sums in tile order: cg2d residuals, means and standard deviations, the area/volume-weighted statistics) except for advect_xy (bitwise in every printed number) and global_ocean, where every dynamics and SBO number is bitwise and only the grid statistics change (they average over all tiles, and the blank tile 30 is absent in the 35-tile layout). Field-scale differences stay at 1e-11 or below; the largest are the w-velocity statistics and cg2d_init_res (iterative solver). Which `%MON` lines exist depends on the tiling: `dynstat_sst`/`dynstat_sss` are printed only when nSx = nSy = 1 (pkg/monitor/monitor.F:121-130, 'print stats only if nSx=nSy=1 since otherwise stats are wrong'). So a JAX layout that differs from the experiment's SIZE.h cannot be expected to match the oracle bitwise in these statistics; the P=1 vs P=N bitwise gate (PORTING_RULES §4) holds the tile layout fixed and only changes the device count.

Findings: switching diagnostics or mnc off changes no number the model prints: the state is independent of these output requests in all M1 variants that use them. The STDOUT differences are the echo of the overlaid `data.pkg` line, the package status line, the package's own parameter print-out (data.diagnostics / data.mnc echo, diagnostics list) and its timer sections; the file differences are the diagnostics/mnc output files themselves (mnc off writes MDS files instead of netCDF), the overlaid data.pkg (a file instead of a link) and STDERR.0000, which gains the package's two warning lines ('ignores "data.diagnostics" file since useDiagnostics= F', the same for data.mnc).

## FD oracle: tutorial_global_oce_optim/input_ad (option (i), Nikolay 2026-10-01)

The forward-only `code_ad` build reads `adxx_qnet.0000000000` in GRDCHK_GETADXX (grdchk_main.F:274) and uses it only in the printed ratio (grdchk_main.F:434-437); the FD gradient comes from the +-grdchk_eps forward runs (THE_MAIN_LOOP at grdchk_main.F:359, 400). The run directory gets the file an adjoint build leaves, with zero values (`reference/grdchk_adxx.py`: tiled `adxx_qnet.0000000000.<iG>.<jG>.data/.meta`, 1 record of 45x20 float64 big-endian per tile, the layout CTRL_SET_GLOBFLD_XY writes for both `xx_qnet` and `adxx_qnet`, ctrl_init_ctrlvar.F:143-151; the zero data asserted byte-equal to the run's own zero `xx_qnet.0000000000` files; meta files copied from them). Nothing else in the experiment changes (no namelist overlay).

Zero vs random `adxx_qnet` (job 27827478): 6 of 9 `ADM` lines identical; the lines that differ are exactly the `ADM  adjoint_gradient` lines:

    zero:   (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       =  0.00000000000000E+00
    random: (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       =  8.80654526529049E-06
    zero:   (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       =  0.00000000000000E+00
    random: (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       = -2.76013737957001E-06
    zero:   (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       =  0.00000000000000E+00
    random: (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  adjoint_gradient       =  2.63378404750441E-06

The `ADM  ref_cost_function` and `ADM  finite-diff_grad` lines of the zero run (identical in the random run):

    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  ref_cost_function      =  6.20023228182337E+00
    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  finite-diff_grad       = -2.70384161726867E-06
    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  ref_cost_function      =  6.20023228182337E+00
    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  finite-diff_grad       = -2.77397556924797E-06
    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  ref_cost_function      =  6.20023228182337E+00
    (PID.TID 0000.0001)  ADM  finite-diff_grad       = -2.69091464666360E-06

Against `results/output_adm.txt` (checkpoint68x TAF build): admCst 16 and admFwd 16 digits (table above); the fcpertplus/fcpertminus values agree in every printed digit as well.

## M2: variables below 10 digits, or not compared: proposals for Nikolay (not decided)

Deciding variable: 16 digits in every M2 forward variant except `adjustment.cs-32x32x1` (PS 14 in both variants) and
`global_ocean.cs32x15/input.in_p` (PS 11); the code_ad variants: admCst and admFwd as tabled. Below 10 digits (all
roundoff-level means or standard deviations of nearly uniform or zero-mean fields, the class of M1's Proposal 2):
- `adjustment.cs-32x32x1/input` **Vav 4**: dynstat_vvel_mean is O(1e-19..1e-17) against dynstat_vvel_max O(0.3)
  (field-scale 1e-17); the first four blocks are bitwise, later ones differ from `results/` in the 5th digit of a
  roundoff value.
- `adjustment.cs-32x32x1/input.nlfs` **Tsd 0, Uav 0, Vav 0**: theta is uniform (300): its standard deviation is
  2.3e-13 here and 1.1e-13..2.3e-13 in `results/` (1e-15 of the field); the mean velocities are O(1e-18) of a field
  of O(0.1). The same quantities differ between tilings of M1's own oracle.
Proposal (as M1 Proposal 2): gate these variables relative to the field scale (max(|f_max|,|f_min|) of the same
record) at the 1e-13 class, and require the JAX global sums in the Fortran tile order so that the cube's
cross-face sums can be bitwise where the oracle is bitwise; every other variable at >= its yardstick digits.

Lowest compared digits >= 10 but low: `global_ocean.cs32x15/input.in_p` PS 11, Uav 12, Smn/Umn/Vmx/Vav/Vsd 13. This
variant runs sea ice, EXF and GGL90 (useSEAICE, useEXF, useGGL90 in its data.pkg): **proposal: move input.in_p to M4**
(sea ice) with the other cs32x15 sea-ice variants; its oracle runs and coverage exist already.

Forward-only code_ad variants (global_ocean.90x40x15/input_ad, .kapgm, .kapredi, .bottomdrag;
tutorial_tracer_adjsens/input_ad, .som81; session 7: global_ocean.cs32x15/input_ad): admCst and admFwd 16 digits in
all seven (the FD gradients of the zero-adxx runs equal the TAF build's FD lines of `results/output_adm*.txt` in
every printed digit), except admCst 14 for `tutorial_tracer_adjsens/input_ad.som81` (1.84096178634598E+14 here, ...599E+14 in `results/`: the TAF reference
cost comes from the adjoint build's forward sweep, our FD lines are 16), and the forward `%MON` lines 16 digits in
every default-list variable. The zero vs random adxx runs differ only in the `adjoint_gradient` lines (table below).
`global_ocean.cs32x15/input_ad` (lane A session 7): admCst 16, admFwd 16, forward lists 16 except PS `--`: its
`results/output_adm.txt` has 10 `cg2d_init_res` lines, the 5 of the forward sweep (equal to ours in every printed
digit) and 5 `CG2D_MAD: cg2d_init_res` lines printed by the adjoint solver in the reverse sweep (another TAF reference
for the JAX adjoint: the adjoint cg2d's initial residual per step); testreport's line count differs, so no comparison.

Not compared (`--`): `advect_cs` PS (momStepping=.FALSE., no cg2d line in our STDOUT nor in `results/`, as
advect_xy/xz in M1); the code_ad variants' admGrd (0 by construction of the forward-only build, as optim); their adm
T/S/U/V rows (`ad_dynstat_ad*`): unlike optim, `results/output_adm*.txt` of these seven variants HAS the TAF adjoint
monitor lines (table "TAF adjoint monitor lines" below), but a forward-only build prints none. Proposals: the JAX adjoint gradient against
`results/output_adm*.txt` at >= 10 digits (plan Overview) and against the oracle FD gradient by the trust protocol;
the JAX adjoint monitor (`%MON ad_dynstat_ad*`) against these TAF lines is the first reference comparison of it
(plan Task 16): digits recorded at the first measurement, threshold proposed then.

## M2: TAF adjoint monitor lines in `results/output_adm*.txt` (reference for the JAX adjoint monitor)

Upstream's adjoint builds print one `%MON ad_*` block per iteration of the reverse sweep (MONITOR in adjoint mode, adMonitorFreq; `ad_time_tsnumber` starts each block), from nIter0+nTimeSteps down to nIter0. Our forward-only builds print none; these blocks are what a JAX adjoint monitor reproduces. Fields: group (statistics); `ad_time_secondsf` is in every block as well. *Check list* = the groups testreport's adm check list reads (`tools/testreport_jax.py`, the variant's listVar; testreport compares them over all blocks). ## M3: variables below 10 digits, or not compared: proposals for Nikolay (not decided)

Deciding variable 16 digits in all 24 M3 variants; every compared variable 16 digits in front_relax (5),
ideal_2D_oce (2), tutorial_reentrant_channel, MLAdjust (7), global_ocean.90x40x15 input.dwnslp/input.idemix,
vermix/input, .ggl90, .gglLC. Lower ones, all in the 1-D vermix column:
- `vermix/input.my82`, `.opps`, `.pp81` **Ssd 1**: salt is uniform (35 everywhere, `dynstat_salt_max` = 35.0); its
  standard deviation is roundoff, 6e-15..3e-14 here and in `results/` (1e-15 of the field), the class of M1 Proposal 2.
- `vermix/input.my82` **Vmx 8**, `.pp81` **Vmx 9**: `dynstat_vvel_max` is O(1e-91..1e-85) (v is zero up to the first
  roundoff of a Coriolis term in a column forced only in x); the differing digits are noise on a value 1e85 below the
  u field. Further 10-14 digits in the same runs (Tmx 13, Umn/Umx 10, Usd/Vsd 10-11; input.dd Tmn/Tmx/Smx/Ssd 14,
  opps Umn 13) are against `results/` (another build); our plain, dumps-off and dumps-on runs agree in every printed
  digit (invisibility table).
Proposal (as M1 Proposal 2): gate the means and standard deviations relative to the field scale at the 1e-13 class,
and the extreme values of a field that is zero up to roundoff (vermix v) relative to the scale of the velocity field
(max |u|, |v|); every other variable at >= its yardstick digits.

Not compared (`--`): `global_ocean.90x40x15/input.idemix` sbo_M, sboFW, sboAc, sboAp (no useSBO in its data.pkg: no
`%SBO` line in our STDOUT nor in `results/output.idemix.txt`).

## M4: variables below 10 digits, or not compared: proposals for Nikolay (not decided)

The table below is generated from the yardstick rows (every compared check-list variable of an M4 variant below 10
digits; admGrd of the forward-only code_ad builds excluded, 0 by construction as in M1/M2). Our plain, dumps-off and
dumps-on runs agree in every printed digit for all 31 M4 variants (invisibility table), so these are differences of
our gfortran -O0 build of master against `results/` (written on another platform), not of the instrumentation.
- `lab_sea/input.hb87` (adaptive EVP: data.seaice SEAICEaEVPcoeff=0.5, SEAICEnEVPstarSteps=500,
  useHB87stressCoupling=.TRUE.): PS, Uav, Vav at 4 digits, Usd and hSImx at 5, the other ocean and ice statistics at
  6-9, the lowest of any variant so far; every other lab_sea variant (LSR, free drift, salt plume) is 16 everywhere.
- `seaice_itd/input.thermo` (LSR with LSR_ERROR=1.E-12, SEAICElinearIterMax=1500, its data.seaice): the ice-velocity
  statistics uSI*/vSI* at 6-9 digits, aSIav/aSIsd 8, hSIsd 9 (input and input.lipscomb07: 12 and more).
Proposal: first repeat each of the two on a second platform build (or with -O0 vs the testreport `-ieee` flags compared
line by line over the run) before any acceptance number is set for them; until then their acceptance is our own
oracle (bitwise / >= 13 digits), not `results/`. Every other M4 variable is >= 10 digits (cs32x15 sea-ice variants:
PS 11, as in M2 `input`).

Not compared (`--`): PS of offline_exf_seaice and seaice_itd (the ocean is not stepped: no cg2d call, no
`cg2d_init_res` line in our STDOUT nor in `results/`), and the forward variables of the forward-only code_ad variants'
adm lists (as M2: the adjoint build's `results/output_adm*.txt` has no matching forward block; the forward list rows
compare them).
